ValidationRule.description: The $ per SF fee method needs both Size and Gross Fee Rate per SF.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.TC_Bypass_Settings__c.TC_Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), AND(ISPICKVAL(TC_Gross_Fee_Method__c, "By $ per SF"), OR(ISBLANK(TC_Size__c), ISBLANK(TC_Gross_Fee_Rate_per_UOM__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The $ per SF fee method needs both Size and Gross Fee Rate per SF.
